svg.title: Large-ship routes link Honolulu with Kahului, Nawiliwili, and Hilo, and run northeast to the U.S. mainland

cc:Work.dc:title: Large-ship routes link Honolulu with Kahului, Nawiliwili, and Hilo, and run northeast to the U.S. mainland
cc:Work.dc:description: Map of the main Hawaiian Islands. Gray dots show every cell a large ship crossed; blue route cells connect Honolulu and Kalaeloa with Kahului, Nawiliwili, and Hilo and run northeast toward the mainland. Kawaihae is off the routes.
